name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
summary: Support package for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools: skill training with a stipend, a toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit in two tranches.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
implementing_agency: Ministry of MSME with Ministry of Skill Development and Department of Financial Services
benefit_description: Collateral-free enterprise development loan of up to Rs 1 lakh in the first tranche and up to Rs 2 lakh in the second, at a concessional interest rate, plus a toolkit incentive and a stipend during skill training.

criteria.description: The applicant must be working in one of the trades recognised under the scheme, in the traditional crafts sector.
The applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools, engaged in the trade on a self-employed basis in the unorganised sector.
The applicant must be at least 18 years old at the time of registration, and must not have taken a similar credit-based loan under comparable central or state schemes in recent years.
Government employees and their family members are not eligible, and only one member per family may benefit.

document_requirements.document_name: Aadhaar and mobile number linked for verification
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Existing Aadhaar. Registration is biometric, done at a Common Service Centre, so the Aadhaar record must be current.
An account in the applicant's own name is needed for the toolkit incentive and stipend to be credited.

windows.notes: Registration is through Common Service Centres on a rolling basis, followed by three-stage verification at village, district and screening committee level. The verification chain, not the application, is what takes the time.

benefits.description: Collateral-free credit up to Rs 1 lakh, then up to Rs 2 lakh on repayment of the first tranche, at a concessional rate, plus a toolkit incentive and a training stipend.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: The second tranche requires the first to have been repaid and standard digital transaction or training conditions to be met.
